spans.s: अम् 1. अम्, ind. quickly, a little.

अम् 2. अम्, cl. 1. P. अमति, -मितुम्, Ved.
अमिति or अमीति, to go; to go to or towards;
to serve or honour; to sound: Caus. आमयति, -यि-
तुम्, to afflict with sickness or pain from disease; to
be afflicted or sick.

आम् आम्, ind. an interjection of assent or
recollection, (a vocative following this particle is अनु-
दात्त.)
